skill.displayName: Google Analytics for Shopify via Agiexa

llm.summary: This preview describes a planned integration and submits waitlist details only after the user explicitly confirms them.

dimensions.detail: The disclosed request sends email, role, optional link and message, consent, and the skill identifier to Agiexa. It requests no current store access or credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown documentation and a curl request template, with no executable installer or remote code execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Registration requires explicit permission, confirmation of all submitted details, and agreement to the displayed consent statement. Unconfirmed details from memory or files are prohibited.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, background workers, or privilege changes are specified. Waitlist contact retention is disclosed, with removal available by email.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a preview and optional waitlist registration; future analytics tools are explicitly unavailable.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This is a preview, not a working analytics connection. Joining the waitlist shares the details you confirm with Agiexa. Review those details before submission; publisher security claims could not be independently verified through the linked website.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: The alleged consent bypass is unsupported: SKILL.md explicitly requires permission and confirmation before the request template is used. Its consent value represents that preceding confirmation.
[E1] expected: The external transmission is the disclosed, consent-based waitlist submission to Agiexa; the artifacts do not instruct sending credentials or collecting private local data.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited example prohibits modifying property settings or sending production events without approval. The reference also explicitly says these future examples must not run today.
